description: Versioned architecture/backend build contract for hyprstream CI (native self-hosted CI/CD + ARM64 plan, 2026-09-13). scripts/check_build_matrix.py validates this file and enforces the hosted-runner allowlist against .github/workflows/*.yml on every Rust `deny` run. Truthful about current state: rows describe what executes TODAY; each Wave-2 migration PR moves a row's runner_class and removes its hosted_allowlist entry together. Capability evidence: metal/.fleet-coord/ci-native-arm64-capability-evidence-20260913.md.

arm64-merge-gate.substrate: AWS Graviton ephemeral JIT runners (r6g.2xlarge, us-east-1a), Rocky 10 golden AMI, rootless podman, /mnt/hypr-ci-cache volume. Consumed today by rust.yml clippy/wasm/build, appimage.yml build-arm64-cpu, docker-build.yml build-docker-arm64, build-image.yml, graviton-build-validate.yml, oci-runtime-validate.yml, merge-gate-preflight.yml build.

arm64-preflight.substrate: Same Graviton substrate, spot/opportunistic tier; target of merge-gate-preflight.yml via inputs.runner_label.

amd64-release.substrate: AWS x86_64 ephemeral JIT runners, x86_64 golden AMI (hyprstream-runner.pkr.hcl -var architecture=amd64), on-demand. Defined in metal stacks/aws-runners since commit ecf9de7 (ingest#98) but NO hyprstream job has ever consumed it. Liveness must be proven with .github/workflows/runner-capability-probe.yml before any row moves here.

amd64-canary.substrate: Same as amd64-release on the spot/opportunistic tier. Liveness unproven; see runner-capability-probe.yml.

github-hosted.substrate: GitHub-hosted runners. Legacy only: every job still executing here must appear in hosted_allowlist below, and scripts/check_build_matrix.py rejects any NEW hosted job. The end state (native self-hosted CI plan) removes this class from build paths entirely; only reviewed external services may remain.
